question.question: Which revised layout works best with Workspace as a dropdown and Enabled last?

content.text: Both changes are now fixed: Workspace is a dropdown, and Enabled is the final standalone setting. B is still my recommendation because its quiet sections keep every setting visible without adding card navigation. F makes Enabled a separate fifth point if you prefer the numbered guide.

A remains the actual current capture for reference. B–F are revised at the same 368 × 964 panel size. All previous header/footer and real configured-model requirements remain unchanged. No layout was accepted from the earlier comments-only response.
Actual current baseline. Choosing this retains the flat organization but still applies your dropdown, final Enabled, header, and footer requirements.
